sections.note: rc2c8; two answers (rc4, rc5) plus rc2c8c3 promoted out of accordion

proposed_rules.trigger: Pair of [2x1] nodes at bottom of main content: tagline + pipe-separated link list, identical structure across pages, before cookie overlay.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as global site footer fragment; exclude from page block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same pattern as knack-announcement-bar but at page bottom; recurs across unrelated templates.

proposed_rules.trigger: FAQ accordion answer ([region]) rendered as a root-level or out-of-accordion sibling instead of nested in its question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold back into the FAQ block as the matching row's answer cell instead of a new section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Overlay/absolute positioning during capture detaches expanded FAQ answers from their DOM parent.

provenance.evidence: C140 rc4, rc5 [region] floating; rc2c8c3 [region] inside accordion but detached from its question row

notes: Med-spa landing template: hero, feature grid, trust/testimonial/pricing card rows, CTA banners, FAQ accordion, footer/cookie chrome. A leaked media-query CSS text node (rc2c9) is noise.
